sessions.notes_text: Called to check in on how his appointment with MUSC went. They canceled his appointment because they already got his medical records from another doctor. sessions.notes_text:
Contact Summary: Completed initial Reentry Navigation phone intake with Mikle McFadden. Explained both the Turn90 in-person program and remote Reentry Navigation tracks. Mikle was released on August 3rd after 38 years of incarceration. 

Case Plan & Briefcase Updates: Mikle has made excellent independent progress. He verified that he has his valid Driver's License (obtained 3 weeks ago), Social Security Card, and Birth Certificate. He resides in a home he owns with his wife and has access to a vehicle. 

Barriers Identified: Mikle's primary barrier is a severe spinal condition that prevents him from standing for long periods or lifting heavy objects, making the physical demands of the Turn90 center program unsuitable at this time. He is connected to Voc Rehab and has an appointment with a spinal surgeon at MUSC this coming Monday to evaluate his need for surgery.

Referrals/Resources Provided: Offered financial or community assistance, but Mikle stated he and his wife are currently stable and do not require emergency assistance. 

Next Steps: Mikle will remain in Reentry Navigation for phone-based case management. Daisy will follow up next week to check on the results of his MUSC appointment and discuss building a resume focused on his clerical work history.
